claims.text: Bioprosthetic SAVR or MVR, ↓bleed risk: VKA to INR 2.5 = reasonable for ± 3 and up to 6 mo.
claims.quote: For patients with a bioprosthetic SAVR or mitral valve replacement who are at low risk of bleeding, anticoagulation with a VKA to achieve an INR of 2.5 is reasonable for at least 3 months and for as long as 6 months after surgical replacement.
